signals.title: Mabane section, Sweetwaters, outside Pietermaritzburg (map point approximate): eight men shot dead inside a vehicle, night of 15 Nov
signals.content: Eight men were found shot dead inside a white seven-seater vehicle riddled with bullet holes at the Mabane section of Sweetwaters, outside Pietermaritzburg, on the night of Sunday 15 November, KwaZulu-Natal police spokesperson Col Robert Netshiunda told IOL. MDNtv reports that police later said the vehicle was used for e-hailing, that two firearms, 14 rounds and a blank gun were found in it, and that six of the men, aged 20 to 30, had been identified. Police had not established how it happened or the motive, and no arrests were reported. The map point is approximate: a point on the road towards Sweetwaters, not the scene.

Area level, about 5 km.

signals.title: R33 towards Msinga, Greytown (map point approximate): station commander shot dead and two suspects killed in shootout after supermarket robbery, 12 Nov
signals.content: Greytown station commander Lt-Col TG Sithole was shot dead and Sergeant Gumede was shot in the arm in a gun battle on the R33 towards Msinga on the afternoon of Thursday 12 November, IOL and BNK News report from a SAPS statement. Police had responded to a business robbery at Lucky Supermarket in the Greytown CBD, where the shop owner was shot and injured and staff were assaulted; at least 10 suspects fled in a Toyota Quantum and were intercepted on the R33. Police shot two suspects dead, a third was wounded and arrested, and the rest fled on foot into the mountains. The map point is approximate: the Greytown town point, not the place on the R33.

signals.title: Ezimangweni, Amaoti, Inanda (map point approximate): three suspects shot dead in shootout with police, 25 Nov
signals.content: Three suspects wanted for serious and violent crimes in Phoenix and Inanda were shot dead in a shootout with police at a residence in the Ezimangweni area of Amaoti, Inanda, on Wednesday 25 November, KZN police spokesperson Col Robert Netshiunda said, via IOL and The Witness. Police say the suspects had earlier opened fire on a police patrol vehicle in Inanda; the officers were unhurt. Two firearms were recovered for ballistic testing. The two reports differ on the time: IOL says morning, The Witness says afternoon. The map point is approximate: the Inanda area point, not the house.
